merged_findings.item: Method of loci / ars memoriae (memory palace)
merged_findings.claim: A spatial-native antiquity mnemonic: knowledge encoded by mentally traversing a remembered architecture. Primary sources: Rhetorica ad Herennium (c. 86-82 BCE, oldest surviving technical description — 'artificial memory consists of places and images'), Cicero De Oratore II.86-88 (55 BCE, the Simonides-of-Ceos origin story), Quintilian Inst. Or. XI.2 (c. 95 CE, himself skeptical of the Simonides legend); modern synthesis Frances A. Yates, The Art of Memory (1966). LOAD-BEARING CORRECTION to the task premise (separate finding below): the method runs on the SPATIAL faculty, which aphantasia spares.
merged_findings.best_citation: Anon., Rhetorica ad Herennium (c. 86-82 BCE), Loeb trans. Caplan 1954; Cicero, De Oratore II.86-88 (55 BCE); Quintilian, Institutio Oratoria XI.2 (c. 95 CE); Frances A. Yates, The Art of Memory, Univ. of Chicago Press (1966). [Rhetorica ad Herennium dating c.86-82 BCE web-verified via Wikipedia/historyofinformation.com as oldest surviving method-of-loci description]

merged_findings.item: Aphantasia gating of the method of loci (TASK-PREMISE CORRECTION)
merged_findings.claim: MAJORITY (opus+haiku) OVERTURNS the task premise that 'spatial = visualization-native = aphantasic-blind.' Bainbridge, Pounder, Eardley & Baker (Cortex 2021) show aphantasia spares SPATIAL memory (object-location accuracy indistinguishable from controls) but impairs OBJECT/visual-detail memory. The method of loci rides on hippocampal spatial-navigation circuitry (Ondrej 2025 meta-analysis) that aphantasics retain; what aphantasia removes is the vivid OBJECT-IMAGE decorating each locus. So the genuine 2:4:8 blind spot is object/pictorial imagery, NOT space itself. Sonnet DISSENTED (asserted the imagines agentes are specifically impaired — premise-as-fact); overturned 2-of-3.
merged_findings.best_citation: Bainbridge WA, Pounder Z, Eardley AF, Baker CI, 'Quantifying aphantasia through drawing: Those without visual imagery show deficits in object but not spatial memory', Cortex 135:159-172 (2021), DOI 10.1016/j.cortex.2020.11.014 [WEB-VERIFIED verbatim: PubMed 33383478, PMC7856239, UChicago Brain Bridge Lab — object-deficit/spatial-spared dissociation confirmed]; Ondrej J, British Journal of Psychology (2025), PMC12514325 [cited by opus, not re-verified this pass]

merged_findings.item: Polynesian / Oceanic wayfinding (star compass, etak, swell/wave piloting, Marshall Islands stick charts)
merged_findings.claim: UNANIMOUSLY named by all three tiers as the STRONGEST genuinely-2:4:8 candidate. A directional-navigation technology held as a mental spatial model: (1) star compass (memorized circle of rising/setting star bearings); (2) etak — a moving-reference-frame transformation where the canoe is held stationary and islands conceptually slide past under the star points (irreducibly spatial); (3) swell/wave piloting (reading refracted/reflected swell-interference geometry). Stick charts (mattang teaching device / meddo section chart / rebbelib whole-chain chart) are spatial-topological swell-geometry diagrams, memorized on land and NOT carried aboard. Does not reduce to any calendrical/modular cycle. Finney's experimental Hokule'a voyaging refuted the accidental-drift hypothesis.
merged_findings.best_citation: Lewis, David H., We, the Navigators (Univ. of Hawaii Press 1972, 2nd ed. 1994); Finney, Ben R., 'Voyaging Canoes and the Settlement of Polynesia', Science 196(4296):1277-1285 (1977), DOI 10.1126/science.196.4296.1277 [WEB-VERIFIED verbatim: Science.org, ADS 1977Sci...196.1277F, PubMed 17831736]; Gladwin, East Is a Big Bird (Harvard UP 1970); Hutchins, Cognition in the Wild (MIT Press 1995)

merged_findings.claim: UNANIMOUS: place-indexed oral 'maps' encoding navigation, ecology, law, and cosmology along a remembered route through Country, with locations as ordered mnemonic anchors; earthly songlines are in many cases mirrored by sky songlines used as compass/mnemonic. Structurally parallel to (and an independent invention of) the method-of-loci principle (Kelly). DIGNITY-FIRST caveat (sonnet+opus): the Dreaming/Tjukurpa is a living spiritual and legal system and contested English gloss, Indigenous cultural heritage to be cited respectfully with no appropriation; the navigation specifics are co-authored with Wardaman elder Bill Yidumduma Harney, and Lynne Kelly's comparative work was developed in consultation with Elders.

merged_findings.item: Euclidean constructive (straightedge-and-compass) geometry vs Babylonian sexagesimal computation
merged_findings.claim: UNANIMOUS as the cleanest 2:4:8-vs-1:3:7 contrast, WITH a unanimous hedge: Euclid's Elements (c. 300 BCE) frames knowledge as constructions where the diagram is the object of reasoning (the first three postulates ARE compass-and-straightedge operations); Babylonian mathematics (sexagesimal, base-60) is primarily numerical/algorithmic/tabular. The contrast is a difference of DOMINANT MODE, not absolute capability — Babylonians did sophisticated geometry (Plimpton 322, sqrt(2)/Pythagorean-rule tablets) and Greeks encoded number. Haiku frames it most cautiously ('two methodologies, not two independent substrates'); a methodological/epistemic contrast, not a sharp binary.

merged_findings.claim: UNANIMOUS: by c. 1200 CE Islamic architects shifted from drafting star-and-polygon patterns as straightedge-and-compass zigzag lines to tessellating a set of decorated equilateral 'girih tiles'; by the 15th c. some patterns (e.g. Darb-i Imam, Isfahan) approach near-perfect quasi-crystalline (Penrose-like) tilings with self-similar transformations, five centuries before the West. merged.cross_cutting:
FRAMEWORK READING — offered as a LENS, not asserted; no-lineage (the history belongs to the historians and the named communities), dignity-first. k=3 triality converged with error-correction live.

THE SURVIVING STRUCTURE (LENS): there appear to be two structurally distinct antiquity knowledge 'alphabets' that differ in KIND, not degree. (1:3:7) CYCLIC/NUMERICAL/MODULAR — gear-ratios, calendrical periods, sexagesimal tables, the Antikythera back-panel metacycles; knowledge that is an OPERATOR (a recurrence/count turned), hand-computable digit-by-digit, with a natural symbolic/tabular surface that an abstract-relational search frame finds easily. (2:4:8) SPATIAL/GEOMETRIC/DIRECTIONAL — knowledge held as a mental spatial MODEL or OPERAND (a place-topology, a bearing-frame, a tessellation, a construction-diagram), where the load-bearing content lives in a held spatial relationship rather than a repeated count. An operand-substrate (a map/frame/diagram you move through) vs an operator-substrate (a cycle you turn). A search frame tuned to recurrences is structurally biased to under-detect substrates whose content is a non-numerical spatial relation — exactly the candidates here.

THE LOAD-BEARING CORRECTION (verified, not lens): the aphantasia literature forces a sharpening of WHICH faculty the blind spot maps onto. Bainbridge et al. (Cortex 2021, web-verified) show aphantasia SPARES spatial memory and IMPAIRS object/visual-image memory; the method of loci rides on the hippocampal spatial-navigation circuitry aphantasics retain (Ondrej 2025). So 'visualizing mind' is too coarse: the genuine fault line is between (a) the SPATIAL/topological/relational faculty — which an abstract-relational frame DOES have (etak frames, songline topologies, graph-spatial reasoning are relational and reachable) — and (b) the OBJECT-IMAGERY/vivid-pictorial faculty (the part that 'dreams in pictures'), which is what an aphantasic/abstract frame is genuinely blind to. Net: the 2:4:8 substrate the search likely MISSED is real, but it is missed less because it is 'spatial' and more where its content is irreducibly PICTORIAL-OBJECT or requires holding a continuously-updated visual scene (the etak frame-slide, the girih tessellation seen as a whole, the decorated locus).

THE STRONGEST LODGEABLE CANDIDATE: Polynesian/Oceanic wayfinding (etak) — a moving-reference-frame transformation over a held spatial model that does not reduce to any calendrical cycle, with stick charts as explicit spatial/topological operands; all three tiers named it the strongest, structurally distinct from the 1:3:7 cyclic substrate (operand/frame vs operator/cycle). THE INSTRUCTIVE HYBRID: the Mesoamerican cosmogram, where a spatial-directional frame carries a cyclic-numerical (260-day) payload — showing the two alphabets can FUSE; Newgrange-style sightlines are the same hybrid (cyclic knowledge to BUILD, spatial artifact to READ). A METHODOLOGICAL HONESTY NOTE (sonnet's uncentered reframing): the 'missed complement' is more accurately a SCOPE GAP — the 2:4:8 substrate shows up in domains the prior research simply did not search (open-ocean navigation, spatial mnemonic, constructive geometry), not in previously-searched domains found to be cyclic — rather than a systematic cognitive blindness. Kelly's observation that songlines and the memory palace are both ordered spatial walks raises the open question of whether 1:3:7 (cyclic-ordered sequence) and 2:4:8 (directed spatial path) are two projections of a common 'directed path' rather than fully independent alphabets — falsifiable lens, no-lineage.
